bargain for a lower price: At the night market, my mom always bargains for a lower price before she buys any clothes.
在夜市，我媽媽買任何衣服前都會先議價。
bargain with the boss: Like a shopper at a night market, Tom tried to bargain with the boss over every hour of his holiday.
湯姆像夜市裡的顧客一樣，為了假期的每一個小時都想與老闆談條件。
more than one bargained for: Climbing Jade Mountain in heavy rain gave us more than we bargained for, and we were exhausted by noon.
在大雨中爬玉山完全超出預期，我們到中午就筋疲力盡了。
beam with pride: When her son walked onto the stage to get his award, the old woman beamed with pride.
當她兒子走上台領獎時，那位老婦人滿臉自豪。
beam a signal: The satellite can beam a signal from space to millions of TV sets on Earth every second.
這顆衛星每秒都能從太空向地球上數百萬台電視發送訊號。
beam at someone: The little girl beamed at her grandfather when he handed her a big bag of candy.
當爺爺遞給她一大袋糖果時，小女孩對他笑容滿面。
bear the responsibility: As the team leader, Kevin had to bear the responsibility for the mistake all by himself.
身為組長，凱文必須獨自承擔這個錯誤的責任。
bear a resemblance to: The new phone bears a resemblance to last year's model, but it has a much better camera.
這款新手機與去年的機型很相似，但相機好得多。
bear fruit: After years of hard work and many failures, her research finally began to bear fruit.
經過多年努力和許多次失敗，她的研究終於開始見成效了。
bear in mind: Please bear in mind that the library closes at nine, so return your books before then.
請記住圖書館九點關門，所以請在那之前歸還書籍。
can't bear the pain: The boy broke his arm playing basketball and said he couldn't bear the pain any longer.
那男孩打籃球摔斷了手臂，說他再也受不了疼痛了。
bear the cost: The school agreed to bear the cost of the trip, so students from poor families could join too.
學校同意負擔旅行費用，好讓清寒家庭的學生也能參加。
bear witness to: These old temples bear witness to the long and rich history of the small town.
這些古老的廟宇見證了這座小鎮悠久而豐富的歷史。
benefit from the policy: Elderly people living alone will benefit from the policy of free health checks every year.
獨居長者將受惠於每年免費健康檢查的政策。
benefit the community: The new public library will benefit the community by giving children a safe place to study.
新的公立圖書館將造福社區，讓孩子們有個安全的讀書地方。
mutually benefit: The two schools hope the exchange program will mutually benefit their students in language learning.
兩所學校希望這個交換計畫能讓雙方學生在語言學習上互惠。
bet on the wrong horse: Many investors bet on the wrong horse when they put all their money into that failing company.
許多投資人把所有錢投入那家失敗的公司，押錯寶了。
you bet: "Are you coming to my birthday party on Saturday?" "You bet! I wouldn't miss it."
「你星期六會來我的生日派對嗎？」「當然！我絕不會錯過。」
I bet he's late: Jack is never on time for anything, so I bet he's late for the movie again tonight.
傑克做什麼都不準時，所以我敢說他今晚看電影又會遲到。
bet one's life on: I would bet my life on her honesty; she has never told a lie in all these years.
我敢以性命擔保她的誠實；這些年來她從沒說過謊。
betray one's country: The spy was sent to prison for betraying his country and selling secrets to the enemy.
那名間諜因叛國並把機密賣給敵人而入獄。
betray a secret: I told Amy everything because I knew she would never betray a secret to anyone.
我把一切都告訴艾咪，因為我知道她絕不會向任何人洩漏秘密。
betray one's feelings: Although he smiled politely, his shaking hands betrayed his feelings of fear.
雖然他禮貌地微笑，但發抖的雙手流露出他恐懼的情感。
betray someone's trust: If you read your sister's diary without asking, you will betray her trust.
如果你沒問就偷看妹妹的日記，你就背叛了她的信任。
be biased against women: Some old hiring rules seemed to be biased against women who wanted to become pilots.
一些舊的招聘規定似乎對想當機師的女性有偏見。
bias the result: Asking only your close friends in the survey may bias the result and make it unfair.
調查中只問你的好朋友可能會使結果偏頗而不公平。
biased reporting: Readers complained about the newspaper's biased reporting, which only showed one side of the story.
讀者抱怨那份報紙的偏頗報導，只呈現了事件的一面。
bid for the contract: Five companies offered their lowest prices to bid for the contract to build the new bridge.
五家公司提出最低價，投標興建新橋的合約。
bid farewell: At the airport, we bid farewell to our exchange student and promised to visit her in Japan.
在機場，我們向交換學生道別，並答應去日本探望她。
bid for the Olympics: The city spent millions of dollars to bid for the Olympics, but another country won.
這座城市花了數百萬美元申辦奧運，但另一個國家贏了。
bid to win: In a bid to win the final game, the players practiced every morning for two months.
為了力圖贏得決賽，球員們連續兩個月每天早上練習。
